steps.title: Form a team
steps.body: Three to six students agree roles that cover engineering, enterprise and project management.

steps.title: Business and sponsorship
steps.body: Set a budget, write a sponsorship plan and approach partners who can support the season.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Model the car in CAD, working inside the Technical Regulations from the first sketch.

steps.title: Analyse
steps.body: Use virtual testing to compare ideas before anything is made.

steps.title: Make
steps.body: Manufacture the car body and its components, then finish and assemble them.

steps.title: Test
steps.body: Test the car, record the results and improve the design.

steps.title: Pit booth
steps.body: Design and build the display that presents the team and its work at the event.

steps.title: Scrutineering
steps.body: Officials measure the car against the Technical Regulations before it races.

steps.title: Engineering judging
steps.body: Explain the design and manufacturing decisions to the engineering judges.

steps.title: Verbal presentation
steps.body: Present the season to a panel of judges.

steps.title: Portfolios
steps.body: Submit the portfolios that document the engineering and enterprise work.

steps.title: Race
steps.body: Race the car on the 20 metre track.

roles.title: Design and engineering
roles.body: Model, analyse, make and test the car. This group owns the Technical Regulations and the engineering portfolio.

roles.title: Enterprise
roles.body: Raise sponsorship, manage the budget and build the team identity. This group owns the enterprise portfolio and the pit booth.

roles.title: Project management
roles.body: Set the schedule, run team meetings, track risks and make sure every deadline is met.

judging.title: Scrutineering
judging.body: The race cars are measured against the Technical Regulations.

judging.title: Engineering
judging.body: Judges question the team on how the car was designed, analysed, made and tested.

judging.title: Portfolios
judging.body: Written evidence of the engineering work and of how the team ran its enterprise and its project.

judging.title: Pit booth
judging.body: The display that presents the team, its identity and its partners.

judging.title: Verbal presentation
judging.body: A presentation of the season to a panel of judges.
